steps: Resolve the latest verified return and newer durable owner journals again at launch; preserve the distinction between an archive and an unpublished checkpoint.
Authenticate saved fit and prediction receipts against the same inputs, recipe, temporal split and population. Reuse completed scientific work; changed reporting weights alone must not refit it.
Recover completed worker outputs whose parent publication failed. A wrapper or reporting failure must not discard an already completed estimator.
Keep paid source captures and normalized partitions keyed by their real request and content identities. Fetch actual gaps, not the entire history again.
Checkpoint after bounded tasks, stop new admission when interrupted, drain admitted work safely, and publish a verified partial return only after integrity checks.
